messages.subject: Difference Testing Using Scaled Chi-Square with ULSMV
parts:
Dear Lavaan-Users,

maybe this not a specifically Lavaan-question, but nonetheless interesting for the community.
Is there a way to compare to ULSMV estimated models?
For MPLUS the manual says something about the difftest command.
As far as I could see there is no such command in Lavaan?

Any other possibility would also help me a lot.
So I would be very thankful for any thoughts,
best regards

Pete

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Difference Testing Using Scaled Chi-Square with ULSMV

On 07/27/2013 05:03 PM, Pete Parkers wrote:
> Dear Lavaan-Users,
>
> maybe this not a specifically Lavaan-question, but nonetheless
> interesting for the community.
> Is there a way to compare to ULSMV estimated models?
> For MPLUS the manual says something about the difftest command.
> As far as I could see there is no such command in Lavaan

The 'anova()' method can be used to compare nested model, and will take
care of scaled test statistics (in other words, difftest is built in).

Yves.
